superseded.reason: The run was killed mid-batch (an operator's pkill, 21 October about 14:30 UTC) after it had sent the r1 'withdrawn' re-check of claim 4 but before the batch was recorded. On restart the batch took its 'before' balances after that read had already taken claim 4 down (project +0.08, keeper +0.03), and its second re-check of claim 4 was refused ('only a live claim can be re-checked', fee credited back: keeper +0.01). Chain evidence: claim 4 had seq 2 when the batch was sent; recheck tx 0x8b1bf00da2d241c5c8c0ebb9e337cbd3ec7e6e84271fa4a55651014210b0352b returned false; refusal_of(keeper) reads that reason. The shortfall is exactly one take-down minus the refunded fee: project -0.08, keeper -0.02. The contracts paid correctly; the check measured from the wrong starting point. scenario.mjs now records each re-check of a batch as it is sent, so a restart cannot send one twice.
